== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Death Star Trooper (Japanese Premiere Two-Player)|Death Star Trooper]] from [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.categoryonegames.com/catalog/star_wars_ccg-swccg_premiere_sw_2pg_japanese/death_star_trooper_japanese_white_border/50647 CategoryOneGames], [https://cc-client-assets.cdn.crystalcommerce.com/photo/categoryonegames/file/3f8f725556ce47559b5510c2b9680ac2/IMG_20220607_0115.jpg source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(4, 6, 712, 1016)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>d6e1304cf88039085995a54fd74dadfd86d59c95a2873c9228c76021857162a2</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
